title: Fix it for me: how far a plan may move each figure
status: The limits engine/solve.ts keeps to when it looks for whole plans that meet every level (FIX1, D-UX-346, D-UX-351). The four marked placeholders are ours, not a lender's: they wait for the owner's figures (docs/OWNER.md). The most use of the capacity and the longest term are read from engine/data/ratios.json, never repeated here.
source: Placeholders set by Claude for FIX1 (10-11-2026), not from a lender or a publication; the owner's figures take their place
loanCutMostWhy: A placeholder: the most of the term loan asked for that a plan gives up; a plan that keeps less than half the loan is another project, so the page shows what stays short instead
priceMostWhy: A placeholder: the most a plan raises the price a unit, as a share of the typed price; a larger rise is the business's own to type, with its reason
priceGrowthMostWhy: A placeholder: the most a plan lets prices rise a year, about the pace of costs (the page's fixed costs grow 5% a year by default)
moratoriumMostWhy: A placeholder: the longest holiday before the first instalment a plan asks for (a longer one typed is kept)
searchWhy: How finely and how long the search looks (docs/UX-OVERHAUL.md §3.2): each figure's range in 20 steps, then narrowed to the box's rounding; at most 600 runs of the whole report a plan, so the page never waits long
